chunks: Sama'ah asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
about selling two animals for one, so he said: “If you specify the age, then there is no harm.”

key_terms.اثْنَيْنِ: two animals on one side of the transaction
key_terms.السِّنَّ: the age of the animal, specified to remove uncertainty
key_terms.بِوَاحِدٍ: one animal on the other side of the transaction
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to sell two animals for one in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the sale of animals in unequal numbers, such as two for one. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that there is no problem in such a transaction when the age is clearly specified, indicating the importance of removing ambiguity in sale contracts.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4008 - Sama'ah asked Abu Abdullah (as) about selling two animals for one.
Imam (as) said: "If you specify their age, then there is no harm."
